purpose: Trigger-boundary regression set for ugt-nextjs-system-test. S* must route here (test the running system: after setup in containers, or after the admin team finished); N* must NOT — the sharp boundaries are unit tests (normal feature work / test-lint-setup), a red pipeline (cicd-setup), installing the stack (full-setup) and production.
method: 3 independent judges, randomized order, full skill listing incl. superpowers distractors
